ggelato

ggelato (Grammar of Graphics for Exploring and Layering Aggregated Time series) provides interactive graphics for hierarchical and grouped time series. Plots are specified with a layered grammar in the style of ggplot2. Each plot includes a hierarchy widget for selecting, reordering and filtering the levels of the structure.

Installation

Install the released version from CRAN with

install.packages("ggelato")

or the development version from GitHub with

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("yvesypher/ggelato")

Example 

library(ggelato)
library(fabletools)
library(feasts)

tourism_hts <- aus_tourism |>
  aggregate_key((State / Region) * Purpose, Trips = sum(Trips))

tourism_features <- tourism_hts |>
  features(Trips, feat_stl)

gig(tourism_features,
    gig_aes(x = trend_strength, y = seasonal_strength_year)) +
  geom_features() +
  hierarchy((State / Region) * Purpose)

geom_stl() displays STL decompositions and geom_sunburst() displays the aggregation structure. Several plots can be coordinated with the fridge package. See vignette("ggelato") for a full introduction.
